tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Dark is the default theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the result panel.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Chips, icon buttons, pressed rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and the phone number. 13:1 or more on bg, surface and surface-raised in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (time in history, helper lines). Still 8:1 or more on every surface; never lighter.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (secondary button, cards you tap). 3:1 or more on bg.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The brand lime. Fill for 'number locked' and success: status pill, copied toast, bubble ring. Text on it is on-signal. On light it is a fill only, never text.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill (15:1).

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Lime used as text or icon on bg/surface: the check mark, 'locked' label, focus ring. 7:1 or more.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Lime on dark, ink on light (lime on a light page has no edge).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on the primary button (15:1).

tokens.name: scan
tokens.usage: Amber fill for 'searching' state: status pill and scan-frame corners while nothing is locked. Text on it is on-signal.

tokens.name: scan-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text/icon on bg (searching hints).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors (camera blocked, permission missing). Always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Darkens the camera image outside the scan box so the box reads first.

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: Floating bubble body. Always dark so it stands out over any app.

families.ui: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Noto Sans Bengali", system-ui, sans-serif
families.num: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", ui-monospace, monospace

styles.name: number-hero
styles.usage: The locked number on the result screen, stacked one group per line (017 / 1234 / 5678) so each group is huge and checked on its own. Steps down to 64, then 56 if the system font scale is very large.

styles.name: number-card
styles.usage: Number on a choice card, one line, groups 3-4-4.

styles.name: number-row
styles.usage: History rows and the bubble's last-number preview.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the state headline.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels. Verb first, one or two words.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Instructions and hints over the camera.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text. Nothing smaller except caption.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The floor: times, operator chip, metadata. Never below 18.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its helper line.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between number groups; minimum gap between two tap targets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen side padding; card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above the action area.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top safe breathing room on result.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, setup steps, scan-frame corner bend.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the result panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, status pills, toast, bubble.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target (Android asks 48; we use 64).

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Height of the primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: size-bubble
tokens.usage: Floating bubble diameter (setting: 56 / 64 / 76).

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons; 24 only in chips.

tokens.name: shadow-bubble
tokens.usage: Only the floating bubble and the copied toast: things that float over other apps.
